cautious_cooperator
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Defect initially to retain the strong baseline against unknown or retaliatory opponents. If an opponent has shown only cooperation for several rounds, switch to cooperation to gain the mutual-cooperation payoff; immediately revert to defection after any observed defection.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    if len(opponent_history) >= 4 and opponent_history.count(1) == 0:
        return 0
    return 1
```
